title: Agreement Overstates Evidence: Error Dependence in LLM Judge Consensus
abstract: arXiv:2609.22512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Consensus among LLM judges is often taken as strong evidence that a decision is correct. This assumes that judges make their errors independently. In practice, LLM judges are often trained and evaluated in similar ways, so they can make the same mistakes. We study how this dependency affects the reliability of consensus. We find substantial error correlation across both open-weight and frontier LLM judges. In our main bank of ten judges, the average pairwise correlation between judge errors is 0.21. As a result, the ten judges only provide roughly as much statistical information as 3.5 independent judges. The dependency is even stronger among the high-accuracy frontier judges we evaluate, including judges from different providers. In up to 28% of our comparisons, ignoring shared errors leads to the conclusion that one system is significantly better, while accounting for them does not. We also find that the pattern of errors matters. Erro

translated_title: 一致性高估了证据：LLM 评判者共识中的错误依赖性
translated_abstract: LLM 评判者之间的共识通常被视为决策正确的有力证据，但这依赖于评判者的错误相互独立这一假设。然而在实践中，LLM 评判者往往以相似的方式进行训练和评估，因此可能犯相同的错误。我们研究了这种依赖性如何影响共识的可靠性。我们发现，在开源权重模型和前沿 LLM 评判者中都存在显著的错误相关性。在我们包含十个评判者的主要评判组中，评判者错误之间的平均两两相关系数为 0.21。因此，这十个评判者所能提供的统计信息仅相当于约 3.5 个独立评判者。在我们评估的高准确率前沿评判者中，这种依赖性甚至更强，其中包括来自不同提供商的评判者。在多达 28% 的比较中，忽略共同错误会得出一个系统显著优于另一个系统的结论，而考虑这些错误后则不会得出该结论。我们还发现，错误的模式同样重要。
tldr: LLM 评判者之间存在显著的错误相关性（十个评判者仅相当于约 3.5 个独立评判者），因此仅凭评判者之间的一致性会高估结论的可靠性，可能导致错误的系统优劣判断。
en_tdlr: LLM judges exhibit substantial error correlation—ten judges provide only as much statistical information as about 3.5 independent ones—so consensus among judges overstates the evidence and can lead to false conclusions about system superiority.
